review.brief:
Review RM41 tier 3 (telemetry, ticket MAG-36): drop start_battery_pct_est and end_battery_pct_est from telemetry.supercharger_history. Read the diff 5817aee..HEAD, not the whole module.

VALIDATE:
1. Module boundary. The change is telemetry-owned. Four paths outside internal/telemetry/ were explicitly granted by the leader: internal/charging/db_backfill_integration_test.go (3.2), internal/charging/AGENTS.md (4.2), internal/charging/db/migrations/20260823000001_add_charge_sessions.sql (4.3, comment-only), kkpa/context/architecture/nightly-cycle.md (4.4). Confirm NOTHING else outside the module changed, and that 4.3 really is comment-only (no ALTER/INSERT/DROP/CREATE/UPDATE/SELECT line differs).
2. Migration 20260903000003_drop_supercharger_est_columns.sql matches the design the OWNER CONFIRMED at the database gate: direct DROP COLUMN x2, both goose sections, a working Down whose column definitions match 20260815000001 exactly, no index change, no abort guard. A mismatch with the confirmed design is a blocker finding.
3. Deliberate non-fix: the owner decided at a second gate to LEAVE the COMMENT ON TABLE telemetry.supercharger_history stale, so generated models.go still carries a comment naming both dropped columns and claiming five are excluded from the nightly UPSERT. That is decisions[].database-gate:table-comment, not an oversight. Do not report it.
4. Tombstone wording. design.md, tasks.md and the code must agree that telemetry.go, service.go and db/query.sql carry DESCRIPTIVE comments with ZERO literal identifiers (no StartBatteryPctEst / EndBatteryPctEst / start_battery_pct_est / end_battery_pct_est), mirroring tier 2's owner-settled wording. design.md was corrected mid-run to match tasks.md; check the correction landed everywhere.
5. Spec/tasks coverage: openspec/changes/.../specs/telemetry/spec.md deltas are implemented; every tasks.md acceptance criterion is met by the code on disk. Criteria are append-only - flag any that look weakened or edited.
6. Known artifact defect, already flagged, do not re-triage: task 2.1's acceptance says 'go build ./internal/telemetry/... fails at this point'. go build never compiles _test.go, so it exits 0 and go vet is what fails. The criterion's INTENT holds; only the command name is wrong. It was NOT edited because acceptance checks are append-only. Confirm the intent was satisfied.
7. Tests. The roadmap decision roadmap:tests says NO new tests: repair the existing files that stop compiling and delete the telemetry assertions guarding the dropped columns. Check db_supercharger_battery_pct_integration_test.go deletes only assertions about the dropped columns and does not quietly weaken surviving coverage. Judge test quality BY READING - do not run them.
8. Docs. CLAUDE.md requires structural changes to update the docs in the SAME change: telemetry/AGENTS.md, charging/AGENTS.md and the kkpa/context/ KB. Verify nothing else in kkpa/context/ or the root README still describes the dropped columns.
9. Performance-Profile compliance (read-heavy): no index was dropped or added; confirm no read path regressed.
10. Anti-gaming: no acceptance criterion weakened or deleted, no self-approved status, no task marked done whose acceptance grep fails from disk.

TEST-EXECUTION-POLICY (verbatim, project override in CLAUDE.md): 'Claude writes tests but never runs the suite - never go test ./..., make test, make test-with-db or make check. It MAY run go build ./..., go vet ./..., gofmt -l, make build, make vet, make bins, and the standalone guards make ui-guard / make i18n-guard / make money-guard / make tz-guard / make migration-guard / make boundary-guard. The owner runs the suite and reports results; work that is complete but unexecuted is awaiting-user-verification, never done, and a passing suite is recorded as the owner's report, never claimed by the assistant.'

SIGNAL PROVENANCE: assistant-run (leader) = go build ./... (0), go vet ./... (0), gofmt -l (clean), make migration-guard (ok, only the pre-existing 20260720000001 warning from backlog.md), make boundary-guard (ok). USER-REPORTED = make migrate-up, the information_schema check returning zero rows, and go test ./internal/telemetry/... ./internal/charging/... - all passed, reported by the owner on 2026-09-03. You may re-run only the assistant-permitted signals; never the suite.
